name: mpx/hero
title: Hero
description: Cinematic full-bleed hero: photo or looping video background with a light black overlay and overlaid heading, copy, and buttons.

blockstudio.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><rect width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#101920"/><rect x="3.25" y="4.25" width="17.5" height="15.5" rx="1.5" stroke="#FF884B" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M3.25 14.5h10.5" stroke="#FF884B" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="9" r="2" fill="#FF884B"/></svg>

attributes.label: Background image / poster
attributes.help: Full-bleed photo. When a background video is set, this image is used as the video poster (and as a fallback). Prefer a subject framed toward the right so copy stays clear on the left.

attributes.label: Background video
attributes.help: Optional. Autoplays muted on a loop with the image above as poster. Leave empty to use the image alone.

attributes.label: Horizontal (desktop)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Used on all breakpoints unless tablet/mobile overrides are enabled. Applies to image and video object-position.

attributes.label: Vertical (desktop)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Used on all breakpoints unless tablet/mobile overrides are enabled.

attributes.label: Custom tablet position
attributes.help: Override media position from tablet up to desktop. Off = use desktop values.

attributes.label: Horizontal (tablet)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Reset to inherit the desktop horizontal value.

attributes.label: Vertical (tablet)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Reset to inherit the desktop vertical value.

attributes.label: Custom mobile position
attributes.help: Override media position on mobile. Off = use desktop values.

attributes.label: Horizontal (mobile)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Reset to inherit the desktop horizontal value.

attributes.label: Vertical (mobile)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Reset to inherit the desktop vertical value.
